initial_query: Find an existing commercial unit to assess a conversion into a play space / baby parking (hourly childcare) for 15 children, subject to confirmation of the applicable authorization regime in Turin with at least 115 sqm of gross floor area in energy class D or better near parks.
submitted_query: Find an existing commercial unit to assess a conversion into a play space / baby parking (hourly childcare) for 15 children, subject to confirmation of the applicable authorization regime in Turin with at least 115 sqm of gross floor area in energy class D or better near parks.
final_sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Attività commerciali e assimilabili' AND surface_area >= 115 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C', 'D') AND green >= 74 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC

requirements.description: The user wants the unit near parks. 'Near' maps to the 75th percentile of the green distribution (74.26), rounded to 74. Only green is activated because the user named parks and no other nearby services.
The user explicitly requires at least 115 sqm of gross floor area. Capacity for 15 children is not converted into an area filter, because no verified regulatory gross-area threshold was supplied.

The user requires energy class D or better. Energy classes A1 through D are selected. Area (at least 115 sqm), location (Turin, near parks), and the childcare authorization regime are outside the energy column scope and are not included in this filter.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Attività commerciali e assimilabili' AND surface_area >= 115 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C', 'D') AND green >= 74 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters commercial-type properties (property_type) with surface_area >= 115 sqm, energy class A1 through D, green score >= 74, and location within 3.0 km of (45.0677551, 7.6824892) via haversine on latitude/longitude. Results are ordered by distance to the search point, nearest first. No LIMIT is applied.
